pages.title: Opening Files
pages.content: Use the `open()` function to work with files. The `with` statement ensures the file is properly closed after use. Use `"r"` mode for reading.

pages.title: Read a File
pages.content: The best practice is to use `with` to open files:
pages.code:
# Read entire file
with open("data.txt", "r") as file:
    content = file.read()
    print(content)

# Read line by line
with open("data.txt", "r") as file:
    for line in file:
        print(line.strip())

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: Which mode opens a file for reading?
pages.explanation: The "r" mode opens a file for reading. It's also the default mode.
